title: XenoScan1: alignment-free discovery of horizontal gene transfer through reference-relative genomic discordance
description: XenoScan1 is a machine-learning framework for identifying candidate horizontal gene transfer sequences through reference-relative genomic discordance. It projects query DNA sequences into a host-relative feature space using a precomputed universal reference manifold and applies a pre-trained Random Forest model to estimate HGT-associated scores. Predictions are computational evidence for candidate sequences and do not, by themselves, establish that horizontal transfer has occurred.
